[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Iron Mountain facility is part of the company data center business, which traces to a December 2017 purchase of IO Data Centers United States division for 1.3 billion dollars, acquiring four colocation data centers in New Jersey, Ohio, and Arizona, though this specific Virginia or Illinois location was not confirmed as part of that transaction in available sourcing this session. Iron Mountain itself was founded in 1951 as Iron Mountain Atomic Storage Corporation by Herman Knaust, a former mushroom entrepreneur who had purchased a depleted iron ore mine near Kingston, New York, went public in 1996, became a real estate investment trust in 2014, and as of 2023 is headquartered in Portsmouth, New Hampshire. The operators own current data center locations page describes its Northern Virginia presence as 400 plus MW across 142 acres in Manassas, and its own VA-1 and VA-2 solution guides separately describe an 83 acre campus that is the first of four planned campus data centers growing toward a nine facility, two million plus square foot development, confirming this is a real, large, multi building campus consistent with this registrys six separately numbered VA rows. This session made a further attempt to resolve a street address for this specific VA-2 row. The operators own VA-2 solution guide confirms 221,500 gross square feet and 36 MW of renewable power, and that VA-2 was the first US data center to achieve DCOS Maturity Level 3 certification, but does not itself publish a street number. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service was throttled on four separate attempts this session and returned no result. Two sibling VA rows immediately adjacent to this one on the shared campus resolved to 11640 and 11680 Hayden Rd, making a nearby Hayden Rd address plausible for this row too, but this session declines to infer a specific number from neighboring rows alone and applies no address here absent this rows own direct geocode result.
